title: pvOpenVDBReader
body:
## pvOpenVDBReader

Reads an OpenVDB (.vdb) file, the sparse volume format used in visual effects and some simulation tools. Each grid becomes a block of a partitioned dataset collection: volume grids become image data (vtkImageData) and point grids become polydata vertices. MergeImageVolumes or MergePointSets instead combine the selected grids into one image (one array per grid) or one point set, and DownsamplingFactor coarsens the sampled volume.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Sparse volumes are sampled onto a dense image, so a large sparse grid can need much more memory than the file size suggests; try DownsamplingFactor 0.5 for a first look.
- Without merging each grid is a separate block; enable MergeImageVolumes when a later operation needs one image with several arrays.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `OpenVDBReader`. Identity: `sources/OpenVDBReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `DownsamplingFactor` | This parameter controls the sampling rate of the image volume. A value of 1 will lead to a volume with the same resolution as the read one. A value of 0.5 will downsample the file by half along each axis. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.05,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.05` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the OpenVDB Reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `GridArrays` | This property lists which grid arrays to read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `MergeImageVolumes` | When enabled, the different requested image grids will be merged into a single ImageData. When disabled, the different requested image grids will be stored into individual blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MergePointSets` | When enabled, the different requested point clouds will be merged into a single PolyData. When disabled, the different requested point clouds will be stored into individual blocks. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvOpenVDBReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
